title: Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage — Coverages Carried by a Vehicle and Held by an Owner
content:
# Coverages Carried by a Vehicle and Held by an Owner

**Rule.** Under the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage, a vehicle carries several coverages at once, one of each coverage type, and an owner holds the coverages of every vehicle they own. How coverages on one vehicle combine on one failure is governed by the product's coverage priority rule.

**Number held.** No maximum is set on the number of coverages one customer may hold.

## The rule restated

| Level | What it holds |
|---|---|
| One vehicle | several coverages at the same time, at most one of each coverage type |
| One owner | the coverages of every vehicle that owner owns |

The coverage types a vehicle may carry are the Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty, Factory Complimentary Maintenance, Factory Basic Limited Warranty, Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty, Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty, Federal Emissions Performance Warranty and Safety Recall Remedy Coverage. Each coverage on file shows its coverage type, its status, the vehicle it is registered on and its owner.

## Hypothetical illustration

An owner with two vehicles, one carrying four coverages and the other carrying two, holds all six coverages; each of the six stays tied to the vehicle it is registered on.
